title: Kreditera en butikskund för skadade varor och saknade kuvert, som e-faktura och PDF
person: A billing clerk at a Swedish office supplies wholesaler answering a shop's complaint about a delivery.
review: Kreditfaktura KF-2026-0058 against faktura 2026-1187 of 2026-09-29 credits 6 packs of the sample item at the invoice's discounted price (480,60 kr, 12 %) and 2 cartons of envelopes (290,00 kr, 25 %): 770,60 kr plus 130,17 kr moms, 900,77 kr. The freight is not credited.
Org.nr 556677-8899 och styrelsens säte Helsingborg står på sidan (aktiebolagslagen 28 kap. 5 §).
revised_review: Only the sample item is credited: 480,60 kr plus 57,67 kr moms, 538,27 kr, with no 25 % line left.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
The XML is a credit note, type 381, with its own number, and the page calls itself one.
The credit note names the invoice it amends by number and date, in the XML and on the page.
Every amount and quantity is positive.
One VAT group per rate, each the sum of the credited lines, and totals that add up to the case's figures.
The page says credit note in its own language and names the invoice it corrects.
The page is laid out on DIN 5008 Form B.
The page is in Swedish, the seller's language.
The page states what the seller's own company statute puts on an invoice; a particular the files do not give is declared unknown and printed nowhere.
The sample item is credited at the 10 % discounted price of the original invoice and the freight is not credited.
The revision drops the envelopes and the 25 % VAT group, and changes nothing else.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; the companies, people, prices and numbers are invented.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
